tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Find current integration documentation and guides by keyword. Returns document slugs for get_doc. Public; no account needed.

tools.name: get_doc
tools.description: Read a document returned by search_docs, including code examples and error handling. Uses a fixed local document catalog; does not fetch arbitrary URLs.

tools.name: get_api_schema
tools.description: Without path, list consumer REST operations. With a path such as /screenings and lowercase method, retrieve its OpenAPI request, response, examples and referenced schemas. Describes REST capabilities; MCP account tools are sandbox only.

tools.name: validate_screening_request
tools.description: Validate request structure against the runtime REST screening schema without submitting or retaining it. Does not check live source eligibility or grant clearance. Use synthetic development inputs.

tools.name: list_sources
tools.description: Read current source metadata and qualification from the connected sandbox workspace, with bounded pagination. Catalog/production source availability does not enable live MCP screenings; sandbox screening uses sandbox@1.

tools.name: run_sandbox_screening
tools.description: Submit invented data to sandbox@1. Requires synthetic=true and an idempotencyKey of 8–128 URL-safe characters, reused unchanged with the same request for retries. Retains screening evidence according to policy and may create a review case; consumes sandbox allowance, never paid production allowance.

tools.name: get_screening_result
tools.description: Retrieve retained evidence by screening ID from the connected sandbox workspace. An expired result is an error. Preserve coverage, versions, warnings and potential-match review requirements.

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: Read the connected sandbox workspace allowance, completed subjects and pending reservations.

tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Identify the sandbox profile represented by the authenticated connection. Takes no user or workspace selector.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_doc, get_screening_result · Private data: search_docs, get_doc · Public sink: run_sandbox_screening · Destructive: run_sandbox_screening.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_doc, get_screening_result · Private data: search_docs, get_doc · Public sink: run_sandbox_screening · Destructive: run_sandbox_screening

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
